passage:
Hi Mark,

I hope you’re having a good week. I am writing to formally request a slight adjustment to my work schedule for next week due to an unexpected family emergency.

Yesterday morning, my father suffered a sudden medical complication and had to undergo emergency heart surgery. While the procedure went well, his recovery process requires constant supervision and assistance over the next week or two. Since I am his primary point of contact, I need to travel out of province to help him move into a specialized rehabilitation facility and handle his temporary care.

Because of this, I won’t be able to work my scheduled evening shifts from Tuesday, April 8th through Friday, April 11th. I realize this comes on short notice, so to ensure the store runs smoothly, I have already spoken with Sarah from the morning team. She has kindly agreed to swap her shifts with mine for those four days. This means all supervisor responsibilities during the evening hours will be fully covered, and no extra overtime costs will be incurred by the store.

To support this request, I have attached a note signed by the attending surgeon at the hospital confirming my father’s medical situation and my role in his care. I’ve also sent a quick notice to the HR department so they can update my attendance records if needed.

Please let me know if this arrangement works for you or if I need to complete any formal shift-swap paperwork before I leave. Thank you very much for your understanding and support during this difficult time.

Best regards,
Jonathan Miller
Employee ID: 11456

reply.text:
